record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Let z(N0) be a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal. The paper proves that the range M(I-2S_-|z) of the operator I-2S_- acting on z(N0) can be closed with various finite or infinite codimensions. Determine whether the situation called case 3 can ever occur, namely whether there exists such an ideal z(N0) for which M(I-2S_-|z) is closed and has finite positive codimension 1, 2, 3, ... rather than codimension 0 or non-closed range.

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Find out whether case 3 is impossible.

artifact.status_search_result: The question is explicitly stated as an open problem ("Find out whether case 3 is impossible") in Pietsch's exposition of traces on operator ideals over Banach spaces. A web search for related literature on traces on operator ideals and shift-monotone sequence ideals (Pietsch's series of papers, parts I–IV, and related work on the spectrum of shift operators) does not yield any subsequent paper resolving the case-3 question. No solution or counterexample appears to be reported in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.title: The Spectrum of Shift Operators and the Existence of Traces
status_evidence.snippet: Studies the operator I-2S_- on shift-monotone sequence ideals and the codimension behavior of its range, posing the case-3 dichotomy as an open question.
status_evidence.claim: The status of case 3 (closed range with finite positive codimension) is presented as an open problem in the literature on shift operators and traces.

status_evidence.title: Traces on operator ideals and related linear forms on sequence ideals (Part IV)
status_evidence.snippet: Continuation of Pietsch's program on traces and shift-monotone sequence ideals; does not resolve the case-3 question.
status_evidence.claim: Subsequent papers in Pietsch's series do not report a resolution of the case-3 problem.
